name: DebtTracker
subtitle: Snowball & Avalanche Planner
summary: See your exact debt-free date. Compare Snowball and Avalanche, track IOUs with friends, and watch every payment pull the date closer.
intro: DebtTracker turns your debts into a clear plan and a real debt-free date. Add your credit cards, loans and Buy Now Pay Later balances in seconds, and DebtTracker builds your payoff plan, shows exactly when you'll be debt-free, and moves that date closer with every payment you log.
It's private by design: no bank login, no account and no ads. Your numbers stay on your iPhone, and optional iCloud sync uses your own private iCloud database.

features.title: Your debt-free date
features.text: Add credit cards, loans and Buy Now Pay Later balances in seconds and see exactly when you'll be debt-free.

features.title: Snowball vs Avalanche
features.text: Pay the highest interest first to save the most, or the smallest balance first for quick wins. Compare both on your own numbers.

features.title: Payoff Time Machine
features.text: Slide to add a little extra each month and watch your date and interest saved update instantly. Plan for refunds, bonuses and raises too.

features.title: What-if Lab
features.text: Test a consolidation loan or a 0% balance transfer before you sign, and see whether it really saves you money.

features.title: IOUs with friends
features.text: Record who owes whom for dinners, rent and family loans, and send a polite reminder in one tap.

features.title: Stay on track
features.text: Gentle due-date and payday reminders, plus milestones and shareable progress cards to keep you going.

features.title: Widgets and Siri
features.text: Keep your progress in view with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and check in with Siri.

features.title: DebtTracker PRO
features.text: Unlimited debts and IOUs, custom strategies, 0% promo rates, statement scan, payment calendar, PDF reports, AI Debt Coach and CSV export.

note: DebtTracker is a planning tool and does not provide financial, tax or legal advice. Payoff dates and interest savings are estimates.

inside.title: See the exact day you'll be debt-free
inside.text: Add your cards and loans, pick Snowball or Avalanche, and watch every payment pull your date closer.

inside.title: See what a little extra each month does
inside.text: Slide in an extra payment and watch your debt-free date and the interest you save update instantly.

name: PawPass
subtitle: Share Your Pet's Care Plan
summary: Everything your pet sitter needs in one simple care passport. Share a live link or PDF with feeding, meds, vet info, routines and emergency contacts.
intro: PawPass creates a simple, shareable care passport for your dog, cat or any pet, so family, friends, pet sitters, dog walkers and boarding facilities know exactly what to do.

Feeding routines, medications, vet details, emergency contacts, behavior notes and house rules are kept together and easy to find, so your pet's routine doesn't get lost when someone else is looking after them.

features.title: Feeding schedule
features.text: Feeding times and portions, written down once so every caregiver gets it right.

features.title: Medications
features.text: Doses and timing for every medication, alongside allergies and special care instructions.

features.title: Vet and emergency contacts
features.text: Your veterinarian, clinic details and emergency contacts, easy to find when it matters.

features.title: Routines and house rules
features.text: Daily routines, behavior and personality notes, and the rules of your home.

features.title: Share a live link
features.text: Send a web link anyone can open with no app needed. Edit anytime and the link updates automatically.

features.title: Printable PDF
features.text: Export a clean, printable PDF of your pet's care passport to print or send.

features.title: One passport per pet
features.text: Create a PawPass for each of your pets, so every caregiver knows exactly who needs what.

features.title: Pay once, yours forever
features.text: Unlock PawPass Lifetime with a single one-time purchase. No subscription and no recurring charges.

note: PawPass care sheets are a convenience, not a substitute for advice from a veterinarian.

inside.title: Hand your sitter everything in one link
inside.text: Share feeding, meds, vet details and emergency contacts as a live link that updates whenever you edit it.

inside.title: Stop answering the same questions
inside.text: Put your pet's routine, house rules and behavior notes in one care passport before you leave.

name: DocSnapper
subtitle: Scan Documents, Sign & Edit
summary: Turn any page, receipt or old document into a clean, sharp PDF in seconds. Scan, sign, redact and recognize text, all on your iPhone.
intro: DocSnapper turns your iPhone into a full document scanner. Point the camera at a page and DocSnapper finds the edges, flattens the perspective and cleans up the image, then lets you sign it, redact it, run text recognition on it and export a sharp PDF.
It's built entirely on Apple's own Vision and VisionKit frameworks. Your documents are scanned, processed and stored on your device.

features.title: Scan and import
features.text: Multi-page capture with automatic edge detection, auto-crop and perspective correction. Import photos, PDFs and images from Files.

features.title: 18 cleanup filters
features.text: Magic Color, Deep B&W, De-shadow, Whiteboard, Denoise, Sharpen and more, tuned for paper, receipts, whiteboards and handwriting.

features.title: A real editor
features.text: Sign, mark up, permanently hide sensitive info, add form marks, stamps and watermarks, change page size and fix curved pages.

features.title: Text recognition (OCR)
features.text: Pull the text out of any scan, read it full screen, copy or share it, or export a whole folder as a text file.

features.title: Replace text in a scan
features.text: Swap individual words in place. The patch matches the paper and ink color so the correction blends into the page.

features.title: Stay organized
features.text: Folders with search, sorting and drag to reorder. Every edit is non-destructive, so your original scan is always kept.

features.title: Export and share
features.text: PDF, PNG, JPG and TXT with compression controls and a live file-size estimate. Send to Files, Mail, Dropbox or any app.

features.title: iCloud sync
features.text: Your folders follow you to every device signed in to the same Apple Account, through your own private iCloud Drive.

inside.title: Turn a crumpled receipt into a clean PDF
inside.text: Point your camera and DocSnapper finds the edges, flattens the page and cleans it up, ready to save or send.

inside.title: Sign and redact before you send
inside.text: Add your signature, permanently hide sensitive details and export the result in the format you need.

name: Cocktale
subtitle: Recipes From Your Home Bar
summary: Cocktail and mocktail recipes for every occasion, plus a simple way to keep track of what you drink.
intro: Looking for cocktail recipes, mocktail recipes, or non-alcoholic drink ideas? Cocktale helps you discover drinks for every occasion while giving you an easy way to track your alcohol consumption.
Whether you're a cocktail enthusiast, a mocktail lover, or simply want to be more mindful of your drinking, Cocktale gives you a simple way to explore, save, and track your drinks.

features.title: Cocktail recipes
features.text: Discover recipes across different spirits, flavors and drink styles. Find the classics, explore new drinks and save the ones you love.

features.title: Mocktail recipes
features.text: Delicious mocktails and non-alcoholic drinks for when you want great flavor without the alcohol.

features.title: Consumption tracker
features.text: Keep a personal record of the drinks you have and build awareness of your drinking habits.

features.title: Discover by preference
features.text: Browse by type, flavor, spirit and occasion to find exactly what you're in the mood for.

features.title: Save favorites
features.text: Keep your favorite cocktail and mocktail recipes one tap away.

features.title: Collections
features.text: Organize drinks into collections that make sense for you: party menus, summer drinks, weeknight classics.

features.title: Share recipes
features.text: Send your favorite recipes to friends and family.

features.title: Fresh inspiration
features.text: New recipes arrive regularly, so there's always something worth trying.

note: Cocktale is intended for adults of legal drinking age. Please drink responsibly.

inside.title: Mix something new from your home bar
inside.text: Browse cocktails by spirit, flavor and occasion, save your favorites and group them into collections.

inside.title: Keep an eye on what you drink
inside.text: Log your drinks in a personal tracker and find alcohol-free ideas for nights you'd rather skip it.

name: FlirtWise
subtitle: Rizz Openers & Texting Replies
summary: Your AI wingman for dating apps. Get ready-to-send replies, openers that beat "hey", and a sharper profile.
intro: FlirtWise is your AI wingman for dating apps. It helps you know exactly what to say, whoever you're talking to.
Stuck on a reply? Staring at a profile with no idea how to start? Paste a chat or drop in a screenshot and FlirtWise gives you three ready-to-send messages in the vibe you choose.

features.title: Reply
features.text: Paste a conversation or upload screenshots and get 3 natural replies. Pick a vibe, copy your favorite, or ask for more like it.

features.title: Openers
features.text: Turn a profile, bio or prompt into 3 openers that beat "hey", each with a note on why it works.

features.title: Profile glow-up
features.text: Get a 0–100 score for your bio and prompts, 3 clear fixes and a rewritten version you can use right away.

features.title: Match actions
features.text: Save matches, then reply, revive a quiet chat, ask them out or get date ideas, all kept in that match's history.

features.title: AI wingman chat
features.text: Keep a running conversation with your wingman, decode a confusing message and get quick reply options.

features.title: Guides and tips
features.text: 21 short guides and 60 practical tips on openers, conversation flow, asking out, confidence and respect.

features.title: Built for everyone
features.text: Men, women, non-binary and LGBTQ+ users alike. It respects pronouns and adapts to each dating app's culture.

features.title: Your data, your choice
features.text: FlirtWise asks before any text is sent to an AI provider, and you can turn AI processing off at any time.

note: FlirtWise is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tinder, Hinge, Bumble, Grindr, HER, Feeld, Raya or any other dating app.

inside.title: Open with something better than “hey”
inside.text: Drop in a profile or prompt and get openers you can send, each with a note on why it works.

inside.title: Get unstuck on a reply
inside.text: Paste the chat or add screenshots, pick a vibe and choose from ready-to-send replies.

name: WealthWise
subtitle: Expense Tracker, Money Manager
summary: A simple, private budget and expense tracker with AI insights. No account, no bank linking, and your data stays on your device.
intro: Master your money and achieve your financial goals with WealthWise, the simple, private, all-in-one budget and expense tracker that works entirely on your device.
Whether you're saving for a goal, trying to cut spending, or simply want to understand where your money goes, WealthWise gives you the tools to take control.

features.title: Expense logging
features.text: Log unlimited transactions and see a clear monthly overview of where your money goes.

features.title: Financial Health Score
features.text: One number tracking savings rate, budget discipline, spending steadiness and income, showing what's holding you back.

features.title: Month-end forecast
features.text: See where your spending lands before the month is over, including recurring bills that haven't been charged yet.

features.title: What Changed
features.text: Spots when a category runs hot, a charge is unusually large, or something new appears, with a next step attached.

features.title: Subscription audit
features.text: Finds charges that quietly repeat, even ones you never labelled, and shows what each really costs per year.

features.title: Goal planner
features.text: Set a savings target and instantly see whether it's realistic, plus a plan for exactly where the money comes from.

features.title: Ask WealthWise
features.text: Ask any question about your spending in plain English and get answers from your real transactions.

features.title: Reports and export
features.text: Full monthly reports, 6-month trends, bill reminders, home screen widgets and CSV or PDF export with WealthWise PRO.

inside.title: See where your money goes
inside.text: Log your spending and get a Financial Health Score plus a forecast of where the month will land.
